Chapter 702: Chapter 9: Fifty Years (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 702: Chapter 9: Fifty Years (Subscription Requested)

The River of Time flowed magnificently.

From the distant past, it flowed toward the endless future.

In the River of Time, Tenth Rank beings barely counted as small fish and shrimp.

They were only slightly better than “intermediates.”

Beings of the Eleventh Rank could be considered big fish.

Some especially unique existences within the Eleventh Rank exhibited forms in the River of Time that could be described as colossal, covering a substantial part of the riverbed.

...

“Am I also considered a big fish now?”

Lin Yuan examined himself, though he was only a Tenth Rank Life.

But his foundation was so robust that, reflected within the River of Time, he was fully comparable to those Eleventh-Rank Lives.

“I wonder what my size will be like in the River of Time when I step into the Eleventh Rank, or even the peak of the Eleventh Rank?”

Lin Yuan silently pondered.

The forms of all beings reflected in the river depended solely on the essence of life.

They were unaffected by external forces.

…

While Lin Yuan was feeling the intense fluctuations of the Rule of Time and examining himself,

The Xia Qin Supreme Being had already fished out all the Evolvers on the resurrection list.

These Evolvers, upon returning to the present spacetime, immediately started ‘synchronizing’ their memories, stopping right before their deaths.

The River of Time was vast and endless; even a mere tributary contained countless lives.

Thus, for a Supreme Being to resurrect a certain strong being, it was essential to lock onto their life brand which would act as a “guiding mark.”

Without a life brand serving as a “guiding mark,” even a Supreme Being could not locate the life they wished to resurrect precisely within the vast River of Time.

Supreme Beings may step out of the River of Time, but that doesn’t mean they control it.

“Where is this?”

“Have I been resurrected?”

“I remember fighting fiercely with a warrior from the Prison Tribe in the A076 Battlefield and then suddenly dying…”

Countless Evolvers who were fished out showed confusion in their eyes at first, followed by a swift realization.

In human civilization, the fact that Supreme Beings had resurrection capabilities was no secret, especially among Evolvers who were resurrected, who generally knew the possibility of their resurrection by a Supreme Being.

Once the Xia Qin Supreme Being completed the resurrection tasks on the list, he glanced at the multitude of resurrected Evolvers and then disappeared.

Soon after, Evolvers from the Xia You Evolution Tower stepped forward to guide these recently resurrected Evolvers.

A significant portion of the Evolvers had died tens of thousands of years ago; they were unfamiliar with the current era and needed time to acclimate.

“I… I’ve been resurrected too?”

The resurrected Evolvers were divided into different circles based on their strength.

Sixth Rank Evolvers had their circle, Seventh Rank Evolvers theirs, Eighth Rank Evolvers theirs, and Ninth Rank Evolvers theirs.

As a freshly promoted Sixth Rank Evolver, Fang Qing naturally found himself within the circle of Sixth Rank Evolvers.

Around him were other Sixth Rank Evolvers who had been resurrected like him.

“I am an Evolver of the Ancient God evolution path; logically, I shouldn’t have been eligible for resurrection,” Fang Qing pondered inwardly.

Many of the other Sixth Rank Evolvers around him were also familiar, all being geniuses who excelled across star domains.

And himself?

Although he had reached the Sixth Rank in a mere few hundred years,

he had taken the Ancient God’s evolution path, which was essentially a shortcut.

Compared to other normal evolution paths, the Ancient God evolution path had no particular requirements for talent or understanding but only required one to be sufficiently similar to the corresponding Ancient God.

Human civilization didn’t allocate substantial resources to Evolvers on the Ancient God evolution path, let alone include them in the resurrection slots.

Thus, Fang Qing was perplexed as to why he had been resurrected.

At that moment,

a figure suddenly appeared beside him.

“Star Lord.”

Fang Qing looked up, his spirit lifted, and respectfully spoke.

“Correct.”

“How does it feel to be resurrected?”

Lin Yuan turned toward Fang Qing and asked.

“I don’t know; I just felt like I was in a long dream,” Fang Qing answered truthfully.

“Star Lord, was I resurrected because…” Fang Qing couldn’t help but ask.

“I pleaded with the Supreme Being to put you on the resurrection list,” Lin Yuan replied.

“The resurrection list isn’t supposed to be modifiable…” Fang Qing was secretly shocked. As far as he knew, each life on the resurrection list had been repeatedly judged by three goddesses.

Finally, they were handed over to the Supreme Being for resurrection.

During this period, no one was able to alter the judgement of the three goddesses, which was considered an iron law of human civilization.

But Lin Yuan had forcefully added him to the resurrection list?

Fang Qing didn’t know that Lin Yuan had added him to the resurrection list without going through the three goddesses at all.

Instead, he went directly to Xia Qin, the Supreme Being who led the resurrection.

For him, resurrecting an additional Sixth Rank Evolver was nothing more than a mere thought.

It couldn’t be simpler.

“Thank you, Star Lord,” Fang Qing took a deep breath.

Although he didn’t know by what means Lin Yuan had managed to get him on the resurrection list,

it must have come at a great price, and his life was essentially given by Lin Yuan.

“No need to thank me now,”

“Next, I will take action to cleanse the original traces of your physical body’s evolution path,” Lin Yuan waved his hand.

Although Fang Qing had been resurrected, he still cultivated the Ancient God evolution path.

As long as Tuoba Ancient God wished, he could still take away Fang Qing’s spirit will at any time.

What Lin Yuan intended to do was to completely erase the numerous traces of Fang Qing’s cultivation of the Ancient God evolution path.

Only by doing so could he completely sever the connection with Tuoba Ancient God.

“Please proceed, Star Lord,” Fang Qing said, showing no resistance.

In his last memory, the evolution path he was cultivating had suddenly erupted, dragging his spirit will into an unknown region.

Looking back, it must have been the influence of the Ancient God evolution path.

Swish.

Under Lin Yuan’s intervention,

the traces of ancient god evolutionary path cultivation on Fang Qing’s body were quickly erased.

This was also because Fang Qing had just entered the sixth rank, and Lin Yuan, with his powerful strength, comparable to the usual eleventh-rank evolvers, could easily dispel the influence of the ancient god evolution path.

…

In the depths of the cosmic starry skies,

Tuoba Ancient God’s thoughts stirred as he looked in the direction of human civilization.

“The friend of the Galaxy Master has been resurrected?” Tuoba Ancient God thought silently.

Just a moment ago, Tuoba Ancient God had sensed the vital essence of that friend of the Galaxy Master.

However, almost immediately, that vital essence disappeared, likely due to the erasure of the ancient god evolutionary path he was cultivating.

Tuoba Ancient God was not surprised by this at all.

And he had no intention of interfering either.

One reason was that it was very difficult to take action again in such a short span of time.

Moreover, the human civilization’s supreme being who had just resurrected the friend of the Galaxy Master was probably nearby. Even if he wanted to act, he could not evade the gaze of a supreme being.

Secondly, it was meaningless.

After experiencing the Galaxy Master directly cursing the spirit will of his friend,

Tuoba Ancient God realized that the Galaxy Master would not face any threats. What could he do if he obtained Fang Qing’s spirit will again?

It would only cause the Galaxy Master to curse again.

If the cursing failed, the Galaxy Master would not submit, only causing the enmity of human civilization towards him to deepen further.

“Hmm?”

“The Insect Race has invited me to Battlefield A098?”

Tuoba Ancient God frowned slightly. As a unique life at the peak of the eleventh tier, he often received invitations from alliances of peak clans.

To go and support them on a large alien battlefield.

But generally, Tuoba Ancient God would refuse such invitations.

He was too lazy to meddle in the affairs between those peak clans.

But now,

having assured that he had offended the Galaxy Master,

Tuoba Ancient God began to prioritize his relations with other peak clans.

Especially the Insect Race, Humanity’s sworn enemy. Being an enemy to human civilization himself, if he did not accommodate the Insect Race, his options for retreat in the future would become very limited.

“Fine,”

“I’ll go this time.”

Tuoba Ancient God had made up his mind.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Rule of Death… Rule of Destruction…”

“Great Destruction Rule?”

Lin Yuan had fused the Rule of Death and the Rule of Destruction, two pillar-level rules, to form the Great Destruction Rule.

The Great Destruction Rule, a purely offensive rule, was even purer than the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

It was also one of the powerhouse pillar-level fusion rules that could surpass the Life and Death Samsara Rule in killing power.

Since breaking through to the tenth tier, Lin Yuan, besides contemplating the Life and Death Samsara Rule, had also been contemplating the fusion of other pillar-level rules.

Now, the Great Destruction Rule was the result.

“Great Destruction Rule… One of the twelve great gates on the black planet corresponds to the Great Destruction Rule.”

Moved by this thought, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit of Lin Yuan immediately departed and descended onto the black planet.

“Great Destruction…”

Lin Yuan stood in front of the gate that symbolized the Great Destruction Rule. He then channeled the essence of the Great Destruction Rule and pushed open the gate, walking inside.

Suddenly,

he arrived at an altar similar to the path of the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

“It’s you again?”

A surge of black mist emerged, forming into a man in a black robe.

He glanced at Lin Yuan and shook his head slightly.

“Senior…”

Lin Yuan immediately greeted the man in the black robe.

“When will the test commence?” Lin Yuan went straight to the point, not wanting to waste time.

“Test?”

The man in the black robe fell silent.

He could sense that Lin Yuan had probably just realized the Great Destruction Rule not long ago.

But with the scene of the Life and Death Samsara Rule test before, the man in the black robe knew that the tests set by the black planet were basically non-existent in Lin Yuan’s presence.

“Forget it.”

“You better go in.”

The man in the black robe didn’t want to waste time either, raising his right hand and creating a black portal about five meters large.

Instead of making Lin Yuan struggle again, shaking the interior of the black planet, it was better to let him go in quickly to meditate.

Out of sight, out of mind.

“Thank you, Senior.” Lin Yuan saw this and did not decline.

He immediately conjured an incarnation and stepped into the black portal.

It was a space only a few miles in area.

However, it was filled with an endless aura of the Great Destruction Rule.

“Great Destruction…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the fluctuations of the Great Destruction Rule. Under the empowerments of his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, terrifying inspirations and spiritual lights continuously surged up to him.

Just like that.

Lin Yuan’s two great incarnations rapidly comprehended the Life and Death Samsara Rule and the Great Destruction Rule.

His original body and the Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit were contemplating and cultivating other rules, secret techniques, and so on.

Fifty years passed in the blink of an eye.
